#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<vector<long long>> dp0(n + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));
    vector<vector<long long>> dp1(n + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));

    for (int ij = 2 * n; ij >= 0; --ij) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            int j = ij - i;
            if (i < 0 || j < 0) continue;
            if (j > i) continue;
            if (i == n && j == n) continue;

            if (i == j) {
                dp0[i][j] = max(1LL + dp1[i + 1][j], dp0[i + 1][j]);
            } else if (i == n) {
                dp0[i][j] = max(1LL + dp1[i][j + 1], dp0[i][j + 1]);
            } else {
                long long v1 = (dp0[i + 1][j] + dp0[i][j + 1]) % MOD;
                long long v2 = (1LL + dp1[i + 1][j] + dp0[i][j + 1]) % MOD;
                long long v3 = (1LL + dp0[i + 1][j] + dp1[i][j + 1]) % MOD;
                dp0[i][j] = max(v1, max(v2, v3));
            }

            if (i == j) {
                dp1[i][j] = dp0[i + 1][j];
            } else if (i == n) {
                dp1[i][j] = dp0[i][j + 1];
            } else {
                long long v1 = (dp0[i + 1][j] + dp0[i][j + 1]) % MOD;
                dp1[i][j] = v1;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << dp0[0][0] % MOD << endl;

    return 0;
}
